## NoctuList 2.1.0

Bug-fix and UI polish — wider billetterie layouts, smoother transitions, Firebase setup/join hardening, and performance tweaks.

### Nouveautés principales

- **Billetterie grand écran** — layouts wide pour tablettes et desktop
- **Annonces & compteur** — UI clarifiée, priorité appareil plus lisible
- **Transitions & typo** — animations plus fluides, police Nunito, splash de démarrage
- **Firebase** — bootstrap / join plus fiable, messages d’erreur permissions, rules alignées
- **Perfs & correctifs** — moins de recompositions inutiles, cache photos, sync desktop, divers bugs

### Highlights (English)

- **Wide billetterie / welcome** layouts for large screens
- **Announcements & people counter** UI polish
- **Smoother transitions**, Nunito typography, startup splash
- **Firebase join/setup** reliability and clearer permission errors
- **Performance** and assorted bug fixes

### Upgrade

- Version code **27**. Devices on **2.0.0** (code 26) get an optional update; older builds are prompted to upgrade.
- No mandatory Firebase migration — Sheets-only venues remain supported.
